parse_xet_file_data_from_response: parse XET file metadata from an HTTP response object and extract file hash and refresh route
parse_xet_connection_info_from_headers: parse XET connection info including access token, expiration, and endpoint from HTTP headers
refresh_xet_connection_info: refresh XET connection info using parsed file data and request headers to get a new access token
fetch_xet_connection_info_from_repo_info: fetch XET access token for a repo by type, id, and token type (read or write) from the Hub API
reset_xet_connection_info_cache_for_repo: reset the XET connection info cache entries for a specific repo type and repo id
